how_read: GitHub API /repos/mlflow/mlflow/releases (all 181 releases, pages 1-2, page 3 empty), bodies concatenated into one text file; shortlisted with keyword grep restricted to releases from 2023-08 (v2.6.0 onward, first LLM evaluate in v2.8.0) and to tracing, GenAI, evaluation, judge, scorer, metric, token, cost, latency, agent items; highlights of every v3.x release listed
comment: Highlights read for v3.18 to v3.8, v3.10 and v3.9; individual items read for built-in scorer, trace metrics, gateway usage and issue-detection lines. v2.8.0-v2.17 notes only say "default provided LLM evaluation metrics" and "callable GenAI evaluation metrics" without naming the legacy mlflow.metrics.genai metrics, so none could be proposed from them. Not proposed: RegexMatch and ResponseLength (text/format checks, M1), Google ADK scorers Hallucination/Safety/ResponseEvaluation, DeepEval/RAGAS/Phoenix/TruLens/Guardrails AI scorers (integrations), make_judge and Guardrail/JudgeGuardrail (user-defined), Gateway Usage Tracking (only says "request patterns and metrics"), Trace Cost Tracking in v3.10.0 and per-framework token tracking in v3.2.0 (already recorded as Cost and Token usage). New built-in scorers Fluency, KnowledgeRetention, ConversationalSafety, ConversationalToolCallEfficiency are already recorded; ConversationalRoleAdherence and ConversationalGuidelines were already set aside. No removal or rename of a recorded MLflow metric found; v3.6.0 removed registering/loading custom scorers (not a built-in).
